args.sql:
-- Check total laps per driver
SELECT wheel_unit, COUNT(*) as total_laps
FROM lap_times
GROUP BY wheel_unit
ORDER BY total_laps DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Calculate Lap Time Consistency (LTC) = standard deviation of lap times in seconds per driver
-- Only drivers with >= 10 laps
SELECT 
    wheel_unit as driver_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_laps,
    ROUND(CAST(STDDEV(msec_val / 1000.0) AS numeric), 3) as ltc_score
FROM lap_times
GROUP BY wheel_unit
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY ltc_score ASC
LIMIT 5;

-- Find the top lap time stability (best/lowest standard deviation) from drivers with at least 10 laps
SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(STDDEV(lt.msec_val / 1000.0) AS numeric), 3) as best_ltc_score
FROM lap_times lt
WHERE lt.wheel_unit IN (
    SELECT wheel_unit
    FROM lap_times
    GROUP BY wheel_unit
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
);
